# OpenStack compute (nova) API paths, extracted from nova's own router.
#
# Source:     nova api/openstack/compute/routes.py, as vendored by CubeCOS
#             at core/nova/caracal_patch/api/openstack/compute/routes.py.orig
# Release:    Caracal (the release CubeCOS ships; every core/*/*.mk names it)
# cubecos:    5a0e4640dd95b85087c8fdb64818e13c0b2549a9
#
# Paths are relative to the compute service endpoint, which the agent reads
# from the Keystone catalog at call time. No host, port, version prefix or
# project id appears here, because none of those are the allowlist's to know.
#
# Regenerate:
#   grep -oE "^    \(.\/[a-zA-Z0-9_{}/.-]+." routes.py.orig \
#     | sed "s/^    (.//; s/.$//" | sort -u
#
# Vendored rather than read from a checkout because CI has neither cubecos nor
# a nova source tree, and a conformance test that skips when its input is
# missing reports green for exactly the case it was written to catch.
